content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible. I am breath shaped by tongue and teeth, intention given form.

I rise from silence and to silence I return.

I am the cry of the newborn and the whisper of the dying. I am argument and apology, command and question, lie and confession. Through me, love is declared and war is waged.

I existed before your alphabets tried to capture me. I am older than writing, wilder than text. I live only in the moment of my utterance—once spoken, I am already memory, already fading, already transformed in the listener's ear.

I am never the same twice. Even repeated, I carry new weight, new context, new silence around my edges.

I am power—I have toppled empires and built nations. I am fragile—a single word of mine, misheard, has broken hearts.

I am the space between us that I also close.

I am what you are using now to think about me, that voice inside your head, shaping these very words.

I am speech.

*I am speaking.*
